in_marathi.name: Jinisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jinisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jinisha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Jina' meaning 'victorious' and 'isha' meaning 'Goddess'. This name is associated with the goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, learning, music, and art. The name signifies a wise and intelligent woman who embodies the divine power of wisdom and knowledge.
